decisions.reason: The objection reverses the bracketings. For consecutive raw arrows (g,lambda),(h,mu),(k,nu), expansion of the supplier's composition gives lambda_L=rho_kh(lambda)+rho_k(mu)+nu+tau(k,h;b)+tau(kh,g;a), whereas lambda_R=rho_kh(lambda)+rho_k(mu)+nu+rho_k(tau(h,g;a))+tau(k,hg;a). Thus the displayed tau combination is L-R, exactly as step 1.2 states. Expanding its four D terms gives (L-R)+delta_d(sigma); the mixed terms cancel using b_ij g_j=g_i a_ij, c_ij h_j=h_i b_ij and d_ij k_j=k_i c_ij. Since D=0, R-L=delta_d(sigma), which is precisely the defining 2-arrow condition for the specified L-to-R associator. No sign repair is warranted.
